title: Database crash during checkpoint
reason: Engineer correctly identified the db component and crash but misattributed the trigger to filesystem rather than internal page corruption.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container panicked because its data directory was on a read‑only or corrupted filesystem, causing the server to abort and exit.
truth: A data page checksum failure during a checkpoint triggered a PostgreSQL PANIC. Automatic recovery attempted but failed because the corrupted page is in a critical system catalog, leaving the database process exited and unable to start.
